To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the business models of the IoT are not only the business model of one single organization, but the business model of an entire ecosystem, consisting of many organizations.

business models are a key success factor for Internet of Things (IoT) projects, and the design of these models is a challenging task due to a multitude (diversity) of objects, the lack of standard interfaces and the unstructured nature of the ecosystem.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the challenges of business model design for the Internet of things.

the design of ecosystem business models in the Internet of Things, which are characterized by the diversity of objects and their interfaces, the immaturity and complexity of innovations, and the unstructure of the ecosystem.
how firms can design business models for the Internet of things, a new business ecosystem in which the Internet is connected to physical objects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Internet of Things is not a technology platform but a business ecosystem.
there is a need for new design tools for ecosystem business models in the IOT.
the Internet of Things is an emerging technology platform that will have profound implications for the way firms do business.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Internet of Things is an opportunity for companies to develop and implement new business models.
business models for the Internet of things have to take into account the ecosystem nature of the emerging technology platform.
the Internet of Things is an ecosystem, and business model design for the Internet of things needs to be an ecosystem business model design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
business model innovation is a key success factor for firms that want to succeed in the IOT.
managers need a new tool to guide the design and development of these ecosystem business models.
business model designers should not only focus on the business model design of their own firm, but also on the ecosystemic business model design of the ecosystem in which they operate.
